architecture.head: Existing GainFusionHead, same branch-specific E03D-v2 best200 learned state for frozen/LoRA pair; global gain sqrt(1039/active_branches), hidden128, dropout0.1
architecture.warm_start: Restore parent branch model_best.pt selected within its completed200 epochs. No inherited optimizer, scheduler or RNG; same parent for both treatments. No comparisons to weak original E03P head alone.

training.optimizer: fresh nonfused AdamW for each condition; identical head LR schedule; no inherited optimizer state
training.scheduler: new30-epoch per-update 10% linear warmup/cosine, explicitly reset for BOTH treatments; base head LR inherited from parent terminal1e-4; adapter LR same as original E03P1e-4
training.selection: epoch0 and epochs1..30, highest validation Macro-F1, earliest exact tie; also report epoch30 endpoint
training.nonfinite_policy: abort on nonfinite logits/loss/gradients, no automatic precision/batch/scale retry or skipped steps

technical_gate.description: Compare online epoch0 validation to already-known V100 parent validation, fixed before new training. At most1/3510 argmax differences and0.05pp Macro-F1 drift per branch; fail rather than tune if exceeded. Same branch treatment initial outputs must be exactly equal.

limitations: Exploratory seed43 on reused validation; E03T test report already exists and has been seen before this stage. No claim of unseen-test-driven independent confirmation. Cross-seed random splits overlap. Rank8 only is a new bounded strong-head warm-start question, not a universal LoRA test. Parent branch checkpoints were individually validation-selected and differ across branches, but are identical WITHIN each treatment pair. Additional30-epoch opportunity and optimizer reset apply to BOTH treatments; costs differ because frozen encoder needs no backward. Historical E03P failures remain unchanged. This module never imports final_test, encodes test data, evaluates test, starts replication or shuts down.
